The BioWare Community Live Team presents:

'Neverwinter Nights:
  Pirates of the Sword Coast' v1.0

Designed by:
  Keith Hayward
  Rob Bartel

Starting Level: 5-10
Number of Players: 1-6

A tale of pirates, parrots, and peril! As a sailor aboard the Midnight Rose merchant ship, you've stopped in Neverwinter to gather supplies before a long trip south. A most peculiar course of events follows, slowly unraveling a plot of whale-sized proportions. Embark on a swashbuckling journey on the high seas. Poly want adventure?

To purchase this module, visit https://www.beamdog.com
